name: Optimizely
summary: Digital experience platform for experimentation and content.

flows.title: Create an A/B test experiment
steps: Go to the Experiments or Optimizations dashboard, click Create New Experiment, and select A/B Test from the dropdown.
Enter a name for the experiment and, optionally, a description.
Set where the experiment runs: Target By URL to run it once, or Target By Saved Pages to run it on a set of URLs regularly.
Click Create Experiment. Before it can run, the website needs Optimizely's one-line JavaScript snippet and the experiment needs at least one metric.

flows.title: Add a metric to an experiment
steps: Open the experiment and go to Track > Metrics.
Click Add Metric and choose the metric type and event. The first metric added is the primary metric, which decides whether the experiment wins or loses.
Add secondary metrics or monitoring goals as needed, then click Save.

flows.title: Schedule an experiment
steps: Open the experiment and go to Plan.
Select the Start Time, End Time and Time Zone.
